rewrites.yea_description: Voted to pass the House's version of Senate Bill 93, which makes permit applicants on jobs over $1 million swear every worker has injury insurance. The Colorado Senate voted 23-12 to accept those changes and pass the bill, and the governor signed it into law.
rewrites.nay_description: Voted against passing the House's version of Senate Bill 93, which makes permit applicants on jobs over $1 million swear every worker has injury insurance. The Colorado Senate voted 23-12 to accept those changes and pass the bill, and the governor signed it into law.
